svg.aria-label: ESM-2 masked-marginal scores against Kir2.1 surface expression and channel function
svg.text: ESM-2 masked marginals against two Kir2.1 assays, on identical variants
Zero-shot prediction (x) versus measured outcome (y). ProteinGym v1.3, KCNJ2_MOUSE, Coyote-Maestas 2022.
A computational replication on public data. A prediction remains a prediction.
Positions scored: 193 distinct of 391 in the matched set (residues 1–428)
n = 256 matched variants, hashed subset of 6789; checkpoint facebook/esm2_t33_650M_UR50D; masked marginals, zero-shot.
Δρ (surface − function) = -0.035, 95% CI [-0.188, +0.114] by variant; [-0.196, +0.128] clustered by position; paired
H1 (better agreement with surface expression): UNDETERMINED — the interval spans zero, which is not support. This subset
resolves |Δρ| of about 0.15; the external reference implies about 0.03, so the design is underpowered for the question by
Assay-to-assay ρ = +0.270: the model tracks each assay about as closely as the two assays track each other. Function is
measured downstream of surface expression, so they are not independent readouts — though this ρ is lower than that alone
ESM-2 masked-marginal score (log p(mut) − log p(wt), higher = more tolerated)
